request.notes: Follow-up of r6-foundryexam-003 (done, exit 0, 1.07 pod-hours, $2.13), declared in DESIGN.md section 5c AFTER 003's results were seen; criteria, thresholds, worlds and hidden picks unchanged. Why: (1) in 003 the reference net C (trained at the true weights) was not converged by the study's own criterion (4 of 32 nets in arm P; best step = last step), as the review of 003 warned; (2) the neighbourhood arms' no-experiment nets saw 24-32 prior worlds against arm P's 210, so the arms were not like for like. Changes against 003's code (96d04d50): n_csim 1,536 -> 4,096 episodes per hidden world; C 8,000 steps at batch 128 (was 4,000 at 64), fine-tuned C 3,000 steps at batch 128, and a new net Csm on the first 1,024 episodes (convergence in data); FT(128), FT(512) 1,200 and 2,400 steps; 256 training candidates and up to 128 training neighbours per centre (was 64 and 32), N-arm shared nets 8,000 steps (P0s 4,000); every net seed + 1000; review of 003 minor 2 fixed (CLOCK.get) and its note (a failing lockstep group no longer loses the finished ones: try per group in train_groups). The speed guard now measures both lockstep shapes (16 nets at batch 128 on 4,096-episode sets; 16 nets at batch 64 on padded Lab sets) and allows 55 minutes for everything that is not net training. Sizes: gate 2,048 worlds x 8 members x 332 ticks; about 82 million member-ticks in all (003 measured 47,000/s on this card: 29 minutes); 40 hidden worlds at 11.5 s; nets projected from 003's measured 18.6 ms per 16-net step at batch 64 and 9.7-10.1 ms per step of two shared nets at batch 256: about 70 minutes (30,000 lockstep steps per arm at batch 128, 16,500 at batch 64). Expected 2.0-2.3 h on job.sh's clock; job.sh's limit is 3.0 h, max_hours 3.25. Memory: the largest device data set is 16 x 4,096 episodes (X 4.2e8 elements = 1.7 GiB, with wind sums 3.9 GiB); training temporaries at batch 128 about twice 003's reviewed 5.1 GiB; simulation chunk 2,048 members as before. Guards as 003 (Runner chunk, check_elems at 2^30, device arrays below 2^31, data sets as arguments). Deadlines as 003: arms P, N30, N10 with 45 / 27 / 27% of the time left, N10 runs last and is cut first; order within an arm: P0, S, P0s; C; D(512), FT(512); fine-tuned C; Csm; smaller budgets; second seeds; P0[16], P0[64]. PILOT ONLY: hidden worlds are public functions of public seeds, weights written to $OUT, never an exam; the noise secret (os.urandom) is new and never written, so items and Labs differ from 003's. $OUT about 22 MB. Cap: $2.35/h x 3.5 h = $8.23, rounded up plus $0.10. CPU test: job.sh with FX_SIZE=smoke from a git archive of exactly these four paths at the request's code, all three arms, exit 0.
request.purpose: Round-6 study foundryexam, follow-up of 003 (done): the true-weight reference net trained to convergence (4,096 episodes, 8,000 steps), 128 instead of 32 prior worlds in the neighbourhood arms, new seeds, new items and Labs on the same hidden worlds
